bio.text: Jerri Green is the Democratic nominee for Governor of Tennessee in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary.
She has represented District 2 on the Memphis City Council since January 1, 2024.

She was born in Memphis, graduated from White Station High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville in 1999 and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center in 2003; her career experience includes working as an attorney, educator and advocate.
